title: @New York City Center DOES IT AGAIN!!! #newyorkcitycenter #batboy #ba...
transcript: New York City Center just dropped their new season it's so good my summer camp did bat boy when I was like 12 it is a formative show for me and I cannot believe we are getting a production in New York at New York City Center directed directed by Alex Timbers this is their gala production I'm dying it's running over Halloween where else do you wanna be on Halloween except at bat boy at New York City Centre this is it's perfect it's so perfect and then they drop their next year’s season starting with high spirits February 4th to the 15th it's gonna be directed by Jessica Stone who just did water for elephants Kimberly Akimbo anything goes I don't know much about high spirits but I do know that it came out the same year as Funny Girl and Hello Dolly so obviously it does not get any of the same hype as those two shows which makes it a perfect perfect perfect encores show we’re then getting Wild Party this production was cancelled last season so not entirely surprising March 18th to the 29th this one is gonna be directed by Lili–Anne Brown who's a Chicago based director very very very excited to finally see The Wild Party and then we're finishing the season with La Cage I love this musical I love this musical it's starring Billy Porter which is kind of perfect it's gonna be directed by Robert O'hara from June 17th to the 28th this is an insane incredible amazing season by new artistic director Jenny Gersten I love encores I love New York City Center they just never miss for me and this is a perfect encapsulation of that I really just can't get over we got bat boy and don't forget if you're under 40 New York City Centre has one of the best access programs in the whole city you sign up it's free and you get 28 dollar tickets to all their productions just just go and do it I'm so excited
